specification.title: Two runners released together against a database with no history storage
steps: Runners A and B each connect and wait at a start barrier. The database has no history storage.
Release both at once. A runner that executes m1 waits at the gate K.
For the bound, each runner may exit, reach the gate, or wait on the framework's own coordination. Then release K and require both to finish within the deadline.
Checkpoint `after-end`, as soon as both runners have returned: the runner records the state at report time.

invariants.statement: After every runner has finished, the migration's marker count is 1 and history holds one entry for it.
A runner that did not apply the migration either waited and then found it applied, or reported failure (non-zero exit status).
No runner starts executing the migration while another runner's execution of it is still live (its session still inside the migration): two live sessions inside it at once is a violation.

execution.description: Drizzle's db.transaction(callback) on a pg.Pool (the driver default when given a connection string). The pool max is the case's pool_max. No command-tag check, no connection discard, no extra rollback, and no 'error' listener on pooled clients.
execution.form: migrate() from drizzle-orm/node-postgres/migrator, migrationsSchema public and migrationsTable drizzle_migrations, so the runner can count that identifier. The generated SQL inserts the marker and waits on pg_advisory_xact_lock inside the migrator transaction.

server.version: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg13+2) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit

knowledge: Neither runner can see, before it starts, that the other is about to apply the same migration. The database starts with no history row that could tell it so.

api_outcome.contract: drizzle-orm PgDialect.migrate (pg-core/dialect.js) creates the history table, reads the latest created_at, then runs every pending migration's statements and the history insert inside one session.transaction. There is no advisory lock. The migrator has no reversal.

A.contract: drizzle-orm PgDialect.migrate (pg-core/dialect.js) creates the history table, reads the latest created_at, then runs every pending migration's statements and the history insert inside one session.transaction. There is no advisory lock. The migrator has no reversal.

B.contract: drizzle-orm PgDialect.migrate (pg-core/dialect.js) creates the history table, reads the latest created_at, then runs every pending migration's statements and the history insert inside one session.transaction. There is no advisory lock. The migrator has no reversal.
